hero.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production hero illustration for Korean classroom kindness-quest web app named Mumu Manito (do not render text). Create an original warm 16-bit pixel-art miniature village / cozy top-down game map, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Story: a few friendly tiny child adventurers travel on a winding cream path from a small schoolhouse to a wooden mailbox with a heart, a flower garden and a camp with a green flag. One friendly teal round forest-spirit mascot with a tiny sprout on its head is the guide. Four distinct walkable landmarks, charming little flowers, classroom friendship and secret kindness errands, a few letter envelopes, hearts and stars. Art direction: crisp visible square pixel grid, limited palette cream #FFFAEF, very dark brown #342C21 outlines, teal #237E7F, pale sage #E8EFDA with sparing warm yellow highlights. Flat opaque paper-like background, no blur, no gradients, no 3D. Inviting and playful but polished, clean composition with clear paths and no crowded clutter. Full bleed scene in a rectangular image, all major landmarks inside safe margins. This is scenery for an HTML landing page, not a website screenshot. No words, no labels, no letters, no UI panels, no buttons, no logos, no watermark, no copyrighted game characters.

sprite.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production walking sprite sheet for a pixel-art classroom kindness game. Generate exactly ONE square sprite sheet with a perfectly regular 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal-sized square animation cells, transparent background throughout, no visible grid lines. Each cell contains the SAME original cute teal round forest-spirit guide mascot, dark brown pixel outline #342C21, teal body #237E7F, cream face #FFFAEF, tiny pale green sprout on head #E8EFDA, small messenger satchel, friendly dot eyes, short feet. Front-facing three-quarter-right walking loop: top-left left foot forward, top-right neutral feet, bottom-left right foot forward, bottom-right neutral feet. SAME scale, SAME body center, SAME ground baseline inside every cell. Every sprite is completely inside its own cell, occupies about 70 percent of cell height, roomy transparent border; no overlapping cells, no other objects. Authentic crisp 16-bit pixel art with clearly square pixels and consistent sprite design; no vector smoothness, no antialiasing blur, no 3D, no ambient shadows, no words, no numbers, no labels, no boxes, no background or checkerboard. True alpha transparency. Keep exact 2x2 layout so CSS can display four animation frames by background-position.
